title: Blue Book landing case with an alien footprint diagram

tellings.quote: the footprints of the alien was documented in a diagram by the first military officer on the scene

plain: Among the papers of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, now kept at the National Archives, there is said to be a landing case in which "the footprints of the alien" were drawn in a diagram by "the first military officer on the scene". The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells Michels this from his own digging in the records. If it is as he says, a military officer formally recorded physical traces of a being on the ground.
